because: Counterexample on 3c51594 (ROADMAP item 10, round-5 mesh candidate): mesh_dispatch read the time before waiting for the block table, so a claim adopted after a 1.5 s wait got a lease cap 1.5 s short; a_wait_for_the_table_does_not_shorten_a_peer_claims_lease saw the claim lifted before 600 s from when the table took it.
statement: A peer claim's local lease starts when the block table takes it (Claim and each claim of a BlockSync): a wait for a busy table does not shorten the lease, and the local cap still ends it.
